digest.component_or_area: compact/fsck snapshot folding and orphan repair
propositions: Natural fold enumeration retires and cites orphan events without applying their effects, silently converting repairable damage into unrepairable loss at threshold crossing.
Fold must exclude fsck-orphaned pre-snapshot events (un-cited in prior snapshot) from retirement and source_event_uuids citation to preserve the orphan signal and repair window.
Shared orphan predicate (is_snapshot_orphan) must be extracted and reused by both fold and fsck to prevent definition drift between the two repair doors.
Pre-snapshot foldable candidates must defer from folding while their governing snapshot remains young to avoid burying orphans under a new pre-snapshot snapshot.
fsck --repair-snapshots must respect _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE routing on orphan types instead of rebuilding unconditionally.
